subject: SCIENCE
title: Plants Help Life
objective: Explain ways plants support living systems.
introduction: A tree gives shade, plants shelter animals, and fruits feed people. How do plants support living things?

vocabulary.definition: A living thing that grows in soil and makes food.
The place where a living thing finds food, water, shelter, and space.
The substance an object is made from, such as wood or cotton.

activities.instruction: Watch Milo trace the ways plants support people and animals.
activities.content: Plants make sugars through photosynthesis and can provide food, oxygen, shade, habitat, and materials.

feedback.retry: Look for the plant action, then name the food, shade, habitat, or material it provides.

activities.accessibilityAlternative: Text alternative: Plants make sugars through photosynthesis and can provide food, oxygen, shade, habitat, and materials.

items.prompt: Milo sees a mango tree, a shaded path, and birds in its branches. Which statement about plants is true?

options.text: Every plant is safe to eat
Plants make sugars through photosynthesis and can provide food, oxygen, shade, habitat, and materials.

items.explanation: Plants use light to make sugars and can provide food, oxygen, shade, habitats, and materials. Not every plant is safe to eat, and plants still need water.

items.prompt: Maxine rests under a tree on a sunny day. Which example shows a way plants help?

options.text: Trees grow to full size in one day

items.explanation: Branches and leaves block some sunlight, giving a cooler shaded place. Trees do not eat animals or grow to full size in one day.

items.prompt: Milo writes four claims about plants. Which one is NOT true?
items.explanation: Plants make their own food with light; they do not eat soil. Trees can give shade, plants can shelter animals, and many foods come from plants.

items.prompt: A green plant sits in sunlight. What does it generally make through photosynthesis?
items.explanation: Using light, water, and air, plants make sugars as their food. They do not make plastic, soil, or glass through photosynthesis.

items.prompt: At lunch, Maxine eats rice, fruit, and vegetables. Which way do plants help living things?

options.text: Plants turn every insect into a pet

items.explanation: Fruits, vegetables, and grains come from plants and help feed people. Plants need water and make their own food; they do not eat soil.
